A.title: Frost on the Steps
A.text: The stair is glazed and the glaze moves under your boot. Go down slow with a hand on the rail. The top step smells of ink.

Y.title: The Long Stacks
Y.text: Shelf after shelf, every book sealed in clear ice. Whoever froze them wanted them kept, not read. The thaw has begun and the bottom shelves are ruined.

R.title: Scholar of the Still Lake
R.text: A margin note in a frozen book: the old master sat until his mind was flat as the lake. Then he moved, and nothing was wasted.

G.title: Reading Room Rules
G.text: Carved in the table edge: no flame, no wet hands, no running. The scholars who wrote it never met anything that bit. We have.

M.title: Night Watch Log
M.text: Watch kept by the archive guard, last page. Cold again tonight. The books crack when it warms. Fourth night I heard something turning pages.

O.title: A Scholar's Last Note
O.text: I came to read what the old war cost. The first pages are all numbers, killed and lost. I stopped counting. I hope you read it anyway.

U.title: Catalog Card
U.text: Card pinned to a shelf: Records of the Accord, third copy. The first two copies are gone. The shelf behind the card is empty, and cleaner than the rest.

X.title: Frozen Open
X.text: One book lies open under the ice. Two armies are drawn on the left page, one in steel and one in robes. On the right page someone drew a scale, level.
